SERVICE_HEADLINE: The shop other shops send the hard ones to
TAGLINE: Diagnosis is in the name for a reason. Electrical faults, intermittent warning lights and the problems that two other shops could not pin down.
HOURS: Mon-Thu 8am-6pm · Fri 8am-5pm · Closed Saturday and Sunday
SERVICES_INTRO: Brakes, leaks, suspension noise, cooling and electrical. The common thread is finding the cause rather than swapping parts until it stops.
SERVICE_1_BODY: Starters, alternators, lighting and the intermittent faults that only appear when you are far from home.
SERVICE_2_BODY: Noises traced to their source, then repaired. Pads, rotors, bushings and steering components.
SERVICE_3_BODY: Overheating, leaks and air conditioning that stopped working the week it got hot.
WHY_INTRO: There are other shops within a few minutes of here. This is what a customer actually notices.
WHY_1_BODY: The quote comes before the work, and nothing gets done without you agreeing to it.
WHY_2_BODY: A person picks up during opening hours, and a missed call gets returned the same day.
WHY_3_BODY: Whatever came off the car is there to look at if you want to see it.
CONTACT_INTRO: Call for anything urgent. For a quote or a booking the form reaches the desk directly.
ABOUT_BODY: A.G. Automotive and Diagnosis has been diagnosing the difficult faults in Reseda since 2015. ASE Master Technician certified, BBB accredited, and a member of the International Automotive Technicians' Network.
